北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，气温 26℃ 舒适，出门记得带伞哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Beijing, a comfortable 26℃. Don't forget your umbrella!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云，气温 32℃。风力 4级 稍大，户外注意防晒。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Ningbo at 32℃. Wind at level 4, remember sun protection outdoors.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 31℃ 稍闷热，多补充水分哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Shanghai, feels a bit muggy at 31℃. Remember to drink more water.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云闷热，体感 35℃。注意防暑，多喝水！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is humid and hot, feels like 35℃. Stay cool and hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感 38℃ 高温，多云炎热。注意防晒多补水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels like 38℃, very hot and cloudy. Be sure to stay hydrated and protected from the sun.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云炎热，气温 32℃。户外活动注意防暑哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hot and cloudy in Hangzhou at 32℃. Be mindful of heatstroke outdoors.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，气温 31℃，体感稍热，记得多喝水。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Nanjing, 31℃. Feels a bit warm, remember to drink more water.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都中雨，气温 28℃ 舒适。记得带伞，慢行注意安全。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain in Chengdu, comfortable 28℃. Bring an umbrella and drive safely.
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 32℃ 稍热，注意防暑和补水。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Wuhan, feels a bit hot at 32℃. Stay cool and hydrated.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 34℃ 炎热。出门记得多防晒多补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xi'an, feels hot at 34℃. Remember sun protection and hydration.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 37℃ 高温，体感 38℃，多云炎热。注意防暑补水！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is extremely hot at 37℃, feels like 38℃. Stay cool and hydrated!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阵雨，湿度 82%。出门记得带伞，风力 4级 别着凉。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Showers in Harbin, 82% humidity. Bring an umbrella, and watch out for the 4-level wind.
哈尔滨.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳中雨，湿度 82% 较大。出门记得带伞，小心路滑。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain in Shenyang, 82% humidity. Bring an umbrella and watch for slippery roads.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温 26℃ 舒适。风力 4级 稍大，小心着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Kunming, a comfortable 26℃. Wind at level 4, be careful not to catch a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 34℃ 闷热。海边游玩注意防晒补水哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xiamen, feels muggy at 34℃. If by the sea, use sun protection and hydrate.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，气温 30℃ 舒适。风力 4级 较大，出门别着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Qingdao, a comfortable 30℃. Wind at level 4, don't catch a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 29℃ 稍闷。湿度 73%，注意保持清爽。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Dalian, feels a bit stuffy at 29℃. 73% humidity, stay fresh!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦多云，气温 32℃。风力 5级 较大，外出请注意安全。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Zhangpu at 32℃. Wind at level 5, please be safe outdoors.
漳浦.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 36℃，炎热多云天，记得防晒多补水！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Feels like 36℃ in Cixi, hot and cloudy. Stay hydrated and use sun protection!
